No spec subject (release mechanics; no behavior)

Stage: L14 (05a-stages-library.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
Hex package metadata complete (licenses, links, files list), NOTICE complete with every ported-module origin, CHANGELOG entry, minimal hexdocs (README-grade), mix hex.publish --dry-run clean, then publish 1.0.0-rc.1. Commit: chore: release 1.0.0-rc.1.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: common merge gate plus self-gate
- Behaviors to demonstrate: mix hex.publish --dry-run exits 0; the published package installs into a throwaway project with mix deps.get and mix spec.init runs
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix hex.build only
  - Final tier: the four common merge-gate commands plus mix spec.check --base origin/main, then the dry run, run-until-green
  - Verifier tier: the dry run and the throwaway install
- Standing bounce-class checks: n/a
- Call-site Integration: n/a (consumers: M2 rehearsal and M3 replay install this rc)

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/**, test/**, .spec/**
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- mix.exs (version, package), CHANGELOG.md, NOTICE, README.md (hexdocs wording)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no code changes; a defect found here bounces to the owning stage
- no 1.0.0 final (M5)

Merge gate:
- [ ] Common gate plus self-gate green
- [ ] mix hex.publish --dry-run clean
- [ ] 1.0.0-rc.1 visible on hex.pm
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
